description: This file declares the class AdbLegacyInterfaceObject, which encapsulates a USB interface accessible via a custom driver, including methods for creating handles, retrieving serial numbers, managing endpoints, and caching descriptors.

classes.name: AdbLegacyInterfaceObject
classes.description: A class that manages a USB interface on an Android device via a custom driver, providing methods for handle creation, serial number retrieval, endpoint management, and descriptor caching.

methods.name: AdbLegacyInterfaceObject
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with the interface name.

methods.name: ~AdbLegacyInterfaceObject
methods.description: Virtual destructor, hidden to prevent stack allocation.

methods.name: CreateHandle
methods.description: Creates a handle to this interface object, initializing access to the custom driver.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number for the interface's device, supporting ANSI or wide character formats.

methods.name: GetEndpointInformation
methods.description: Gets information about a specific endpoint on this interface.

methods.name: OpenEndpoint
methods.description: Opens a specified endpoint with given access and sharing modes.

methods.name: OpenEndpoint (protected overload)
methods.description: Opens an endpoint identified by name and ID, with access and sharing modes.

methods.name: CacheUsbConfigurationDescriptor
methods.description: Caches the configuration descriptor for the USB device.

methods.name: CacheUsbInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Caches the interface descriptor for the USB device interface.
